purpose: Blind manual reference for one genuine invoice, written from the printed document before any OCR or model output is seen. Version 2 keeps every rule of the PR103 template and adds the two provenance states PR109 needed to classify existing truth, plus the page map PR109 could not express.
rules: Record only what is printed. Never compute a missing value and present it as printed.

Every field carries provenance: printed, derived (arithmetic over printed values, with derived_from), absent (not on the document), illegible (present but unreadable) or ambiguous (readable but undecidable, with a note).
An absent field, an illegible field and an ambiguous field are three different states and must never be merged. The last three all carry a null value.
A value the document does not print but arithmetic fixes is derived, never printed, and never copied from the pipeline.
Do not normalise a printed inconsistency: if quantity x unit_price does not equal the printed line total, record both and describe the discrepancy in document_inconsistencies.
Shipping, discounts and tax are recorded separately and are never product rows.
A second annotator is required where feasible; record who reviewed and how any disagreement was resolved.
The pages list names every page of source_file that belongs to this one invoice. One file holds one invoice; a file holding two invoices is two references and the intake refuses it until it is split.
Record whether the document is a genuinely issued invoice rather than a template, sample or demo: the cohort's composition counts depend on the answer, not on a guess.
The reference and the image hash are frozen before the pipeline is run.

document.page_map_note: 1-based page numbers of source_file that this invoice occupies; a single-page image is [1]
